integrity: Proof uses exact conditional expectations, a positive quadratic energy and a sharp signed drift. scientific_limitations: Scalar interpolating quadratics with independent iid positive sampled curvatures of finite second moment and iid zero-or-one stale reads; not a claim about correlated or implementation-dependent delays, higher dimensions, additive noise, or convergence speed.
title: A sharp joint staleness–heterogeneity threshold for scalar stochastic gradient descent
